elements.description: How much an agent may do on its own: three levels, and the actions it runs alone or asks about first.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The agent's actions; each sorts into "Runs on its own" or "Asks you first" by its risk, the level and the pins

properties.name: level
properties.description: 0 Ask every time · 1 Ask before risky actions · 2 Full auto

properties.name: pinned
properties.description: Ids of actions that always ask, whatever the level

properties.name: subtitle
properties.default: "What it may do without asking you"

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-level-change
events.description: The user picked a level ({ level: AutonomyLevel }); cancelable

events.name: tc-pinned-change
events.description: The user locked or unlocked an action ({ pinned: string[] }); cancelable

functions.name: asksFirst
functions.signature: asksFirst(action: Pick<AgentAction, "id" | "risk">, level: AutonomyLevel, pinned: string[]): void
functions.description: Does the agent have to ask before this action?

props.name: actions
props.description: The agent's actions; each sorts into "Runs on its own" or "Asks you first" – `icon` takes a React node

props.name: level
props.description: 0 Ask every time · 1 Ask before risky actions · 2 Full auto. Controlled when defined

props.name: onLevelChange
props.description: Called with the new level on every change, controlled or not

props.name: pinned
props.description: Ids of actions that always ask, whatever the level. Controlled when defined

props.name: onPinnedChange
props.description: Called with the new list of pinned ids on every change, controlled or not
